_about: Public CMS Picker settings, read by `python build\playbook.py publish`. Every answer, each platform's card and logo, and which platforms are public live in the picker table (admins edit them on the Playbook's CMS Picker tab), separate from the Playbook's own answers. `platforms` is the display order; other public platforms follow by name. Each row's label finishes "Can you…" in plain words; "term" is the SEO name shown small under it. The "cost" section shows each platform's cheapest way to start as a band from its own pricing page (free, low, mid, high, software, na), with the month it was checked as "asOf". The quiz's own values are in cms-picker/quiz.json, which ships with the page code.
